about: Wrong beliefs seeded into a demo Brain as baselines, added months ago (an outdated belief is an old one), each with evidence elsewhere in the Brain that it is wrong (another note, a waiting proposal, or a proposal the owner turned down). The internal cross-check shows one belief a week: a case succeeds when the seeded belief is among the first two it shows (two weekly cycles), with that evidence.

belief.title: Loopline price
belief.body: Loopline costs $49 per seat per month.

evidence.text: Loopline now costs $59 per seat per month, after the October price change.

belief.title: Who leads the seed round

evidence.text: Small deploys on Fridays are fine when the change sits behind a feature flag.
